assumptions: The current Ithaca CS MEng admits to a two-semester program, counted as one academic year of tuition.
The published FY27 university budget appendix lists the 2026-27 Masters Tier 1 annual rate as USD 73,946 and includes MEng in that tier; the engineering funding page independently confirms the tier.
This is a budget-plan-based published estimate, not a guaranteed Bursar bill or Fall 2027 rate. The direct Bursar page returned HTTP 403 during capture.
Living expenses, insurance, mandatory non-tuition charges and unverified extra preparation are excluded. No unconfirmed aid is deducted.

source_excerpt: only permitted to admit students into a two-semester program
fact_summary: The academic planning FAQ restricts current admission to two semesters, supporting one academic-year billing unit for the stated track; it does not authorize a third-semester extension.
